description: Long-term driving trends: distance, drive frequency and battery consumption.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(distance_km)*(CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "value [${dist}]" FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1)

SELECT AVG(distance_km)*(CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "value [${dist}]" FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1)

SELECT SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(ended_at, now())-started_at)))/3600.0 AS value FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1)

SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS time, SUM(distance_km)*(CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "Distance [${dist}]" FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS "Drives" FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('week', started_at) AS time, SUM(start_battery-end_battery) AS "Battery Used (%)" FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id=${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Time spent driving in each drive mode, including mode changes during a drive. Unknown = drives recorded before the vehicle reported its mode.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT id, started_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) AS ended_at, COALESCE(distance_km, 0) AS km, start_battery - end_battery AS pct, battery_capacity_kwh AS cap, drive_mode FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)), ch AS (SELECT c.at, c.value FROM state_changes c JOIN state_fields f ON f.id = c.field_id AND f.name = 'driveMode' JOIN vehicles v ON v.seq = c.vehicle_seq AND v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} WHERE c.value IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT id, started_at AS at, drive_mode AS mode FROM d UNION ALL SELECT d.id, ch.at, ch.value FROM d JOIN ch ON d.drive_mode IS NOT NULL AND ch.at > d.started_at AND ch.at < d.ended_at), s AS (SELECT p.mode, d.km, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.ended_at - d.started_at) AS dsecs, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(LEAD(p.at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY p.at), d.ended_at) - p.at) AS secs FROM p JOIN d ON d.id = p.id) SELECT COALESCE(CASE mode WHEN 'everyday' THEN 'All-Purpose' WHEN 'distance' THEN 'Conserve' WHEN 'sport' THEN 'Sport' WHEN 'off_road_snow_ice' THEN 'Snow' WHEN 'towing' THEN 'Towing' WHEN 'winter' THEN 'Winter' ELSE initcap(replace(mode, '_', ' ')) END, 'Unknown') AS "Mode", SUM(secs) AS "Driving time" FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Driving Time by Mode

panels.description: Each drive's distance split between its modes in proportion to time spent in each.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT id, started_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) AS ended_at, COALESCE(distance_km, 0) AS km, start_battery - end_battery AS pct, battery_capacity_kwh AS cap, drive_mode FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)), ch AS (SELECT c.at, c.value FROM state_changes c JOIN state_fields f ON f.id = c.field_id AND f.name = 'driveMode' JOIN vehicles v ON v.seq = c.vehicle_seq AND v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} WHERE c.value IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT id, started_at AS at, drive_mode AS mode FROM d UNION ALL SELECT d.id, ch.at, ch.value FROM d JOIN ch ON d.drive_mode IS NOT NULL AND ch.at > d.started_at AND ch.at < d.ended_at), s AS (SELECT p.mode, d.km, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.ended_at - d.started_at) AS dsecs, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(LEAD(p.at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY p.at), d.ended_at) - p.at) AS secs FROM p JOIN d ON d.id = p.id) SELECT COALESCE(CASE mode WHEN 'everyday' THEN 'All-Purpose' WHEN 'distance' THEN 'Conserve' WHEN 'sport' THEN 'Sport' WHEN 'off_road_snow_ice' THEN 'Snow' WHEN 'towing' THEN 'Towing' WHEN 'winter' THEN 'Winter' ELSE initcap(replace(mode, '_', ' ')) END, 'Unknown') AS "Mode", SUM(km * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) * secs / NULLIF(dsecs, 0)) AS "Distance [${dist}]" FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Distance by Mode (est.)

panels.description: Drives that stayed in one mode only. Energy = battery % used x pack capacity, so it includes climate and other loads; short drives are noisy (distance is whole km).

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT id, started_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now()) AS ended_at, COALESCE(distance_km, 0) AS km, start_battery - end_battery AS pct, battery_capacity_kwh AS cap, drive_mode FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)), ch AS (SELECT c.at, c.value FROM state_changes c JOIN state_fields f ON f.id = c.field_id AND f.name = 'driveMode' JOIN vehicles v ON v.seq = c.vehicle_seq AND v.id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} WHERE c.value IS NOT NULL), p AS (SELECT id, started_at AS at, drive_mode AS mode FROM d UNION ALL SELECT d.id, ch.at, ch.value FROM d JOIN ch ON d.drive_mode IS NOT NULL AND ch.at > d.started_at AND ch.at < d.ended_at), s AS (SELECT p.mode, d.km, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.ended_at - d.started_at) AS dsecs, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(LEAD(p.at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY p.at), d.ended_at) - p.at) AS secs FROM p JOIN d ON d.id = p.id) SELECT CASE drive_mode WHEN 'everyday' THEN 'All-Purpose' WHEN 'distance' THEN 'Conserve' WHEN 'sport' THEN 'Sport' WHEN 'off_road_snow_ice' THEN 'Snow' WHEN 'towing' THEN 'Towing' WHEN 'winter' THEN 'Winter' ELSE initcap(replace(drive_mode, '_', ' ')) END AS "Mode", (CASE WHEN (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) > 0 AND (SUM(km)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) * 100 / (SUM(km)) ELSE (SUM(km)) * 0.621371 / (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) END END) AS "Efficiency [${eff_u}]", COUNT(*) AS "Drives", SUM(km) * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "Distance [${dist}]" FROM d WHERE drive_mode IS NOT NULL AND pct > 0 AND cap IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ch WHERE ch.at > d.started_at AND ch.at < d.ended_at AND ch.value <> d.drive_mode) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT dn.name FROM (SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(name), ''), NULLIF(trim(reported_name), ''), 'Driver ' || row_number() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id)) AS name FROM drivers WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) dn WHERE dn.id = drives.driver_id), 'Unknown') AS driver, COALESCE(distance_km, 0) AS km, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(ended_at, now()) - started_at) AS secs, start_battery - end_battery AS pct, battery_capacity_kwh AS cap FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)) SELECT driver AS "Driver", SUM(km) * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "Distance [${dist}]" FROM d GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT dn.name FROM (SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(name), ''), NULLIF(trim(reported_name), ''), 'Driver ' || row_number() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id)) AS name FROM drivers WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring}) dn WHERE dn.id = drives.driver_id), 'Unknown') AS driver, COALESCE(distance_km, 0) AS km, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(ended_at, now()) - started_at) AS secs, start_battery - end_battery AS pct, battery_capacity_kwh AS cap FROM drives WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle:sqlstring} AND COALESCE(driver_id, 0)::text IN (${driver:sqlstring}) AND (distance_km IS NULL OR distance_km >= 0.1) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)) SELECT driver AS "Driver", (CASE WHEN (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) > 0 AND (SUM(km)) > 0 THEN CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) * 100 / (SUM(km)) ELSE (SUM(km)) * 0.621371 / (SUM(pct * cap / 100)) END END) AS "Efficiency [${eff_u}]", COUNT(*) AS "Drives", SUM(km) * (CASE WHEN '${dist}' = 'km' THEN 1 ELSE 0.621371 END) AS "Distance [${dist}]" FROM d WHERE pct > 0 AND cap IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC
